cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. I told her you were still deciding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't replace my silence with a plan I haven't made. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take the call somewhere you can stay alone. It's Mum's old bakery.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects B2's invented still-deciding account before disclosing a bakery lease. B4's real privacy check prompts A5's supervised private call and more sensitive family connection.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's cover account answers A1 but misstates the decision; A3 corrects that. B4 rejects tablet messaging for a concrete reason, causing A5 a call arrangement and deeper disclosure.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to protect a sibling and B4 notices access risk. A can be overcontrolling while B is demonstrably useful, preserving warmth rather than manufacturing incompetence.

heightening.evidence: A5's revelation that the bakery was Mum's raises the family stakes after B4 demonstrates discretion, not merely a larger financial fact.

specificity.evidence: A1 withdrawn college application, A3 lease and B4 shared tablet establish what is withheld and how it could leak.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 uses the privacy proposal and adds the key family fact in two sentences. It does not explain why this proves trust.

coach2.inferred: The sibling relationship and family attachment make the last detail more sensitive than a generic lease.
coach2.missing: No account of why Mum lost or left the bakery is required; that history is not invented in the evidence.
coach2.firstDefect: No failed gate; A3 has a specific correction and A5 develops B's competent privacy intervention.
